first_lines: Table S1. Evidence Levels for the Association Between Different Classes of TKIs and Renal Injury
Abbreviations: VEGFR Vascular Endothelial Growth Factor Receptor, PDGFRPlatelet-Derived Growth Factor Receptor, HER Human Epidermal Growth Factor Receptor, BTK Bruton's Tyrosine Kinase.

limitations: declared_page_count is DOCX metadata, not a rendered page count

review.content_class_rationale: Table S1 is a one-table DOCX of the study cohort's aggregate causality evidence-level counts (certain, probable, possible) by TKI target group and in total. The manifest vocabulary defines literature_table as literature/cohort tables, and this is a cohort-level summary table with no patient-level rows, so literature_table is its class; it is not a checklist, methods document, code or patient data.

estimated_counts.basis: Machine peek table_row_count 4: one header row plus Certain, Probable and Possible rows.

review.notes: The whole DOCX body text (about 500 characters) was read from the raw XML; no images, comments or patient-level cells are present. Group counts (VEGFR 12, PDGFR 5, HER 3, BTK 1, total 21) repeat cohort-level numbers; the BTK group (n=1) is not mapped to a patient here. Parent review: the full DOCX XML body was read again read-only (one table, header plus three count rows and an abbreviation line, no comments, footnote or endnote text and no images); reclassified from other to literature_table because the class vocabulary covers cohort tables.
limitations: anydoc is not installed, so the text-document extraction tool could not run; the DOCX was read directly from its XML instead.
Machine draft: every review block must be completed by a reviewer who inspected the content.
